      "evidence": "Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and fixes token parsing in the UniValue JSON library used by RPC interfaces.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes out-of-bounds reads in JSON parsing when matching keywords or digit prefixes without null termination (#28260). Because RPC inputs are typically null-terminated strings in practice, this provides a worthwhile hardening fix rather than resolving an active failure."
    },

      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The change to the parse_univalue fuzz target merely follows from the parser fix rather than modifying test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Directly modifies src/univalue/lib/univalue_read.cpp, part of the vendored UniValue library covered by utilities.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Enforces buffer boundaries in UniValue's getJsonToken to eliminate two out-of-bounds reads when processing non-null-terminated string views (#28260). Correctness and memory-safety fixes in vendored parsing primitives carry durable value across the codebase."
